component.name: FileWheel
component.summary: Convert files with a drag-and-drop radial menu

description.p: FileWheel converts files locally using a radial menu. Add files to the main window or drag them onto the floating drop target, then choose a conversion or file tool. Converted files are saved beside their originals.
Available operations depend on the conversion engines and codecs included in your installation. FileWheel shows unavailable operations with an explanation.

ul.li: Convert images, audio, video, documents, spreadsheets and subtitles
Export PDF pages as images or extract embedded text
Create archives and calculate file checksums
Choose light, dark or system appearance and customize accent colors

description.p: Document layout and media support depend on the conversion engines. PDF text exports do not preserve the original layout or recognize scanned text. Floating target placement depends on compositor support.

screenshot.caption: Image conversion wheel and a completed conversion
Appearance settings for themes, accent colors and hover feedback

description.p: Initial release of FileWheel for Linux.
